value.rationale: Excluded area is the natural two-body collision area for planar hard polygonal particles and mixed-area geometric functional. Exact full orientation distribution for arbitrary mixed regular side counts, exact sharp extremizing phases and robust gcd-sensitive variance order resolve a motivated angular classification, far beyond small-order special cases or fixed tables. The k^-4 vs k^-8 fluctuation dichotomy is a genuine arithmetic geometric structural phenomenon. No phase-behavior or packing theorem is claimed.
